name: Multivitamin & Multimineral [A-Z teen boys preparation]
indication_description: Complete Multivitamin for Teen Boys to Support: Healthy muscle function with magnesium; Healthy immune system with vitamins C and E, beta-carotene, zinc, iron and selenium; Bone strength with calcium, vitamin D, and magnesium; Energy through the conversion of food to fuel with vitamins B6 and B12, thiamin, riboflavin, and niacin.
pharmacology_description: This preparation is a comprehensive multivitamin and mineral supplement designed to help teen boys to meet their increased nutritional needs.
dosage_description: Teens: One tablet daily, with food.
contraindications_description: This product is contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients.
side_effects_description: Allergic sensitization has been reported following oral administration of folic acid.
precautions_description: Folic acid alone is improper therapy in the treatment of pernicious anaemia and other megaloblastic anaemia where Vitamin B12 is deficient.
overdose_effects_description: Accidental overdose if an iron-containing product is a leading cause of fatal poisoning in children under 6. Keep this product out of reach of children. In case of accidental overdose, call a doctor or poison control center immediately. Do not use this product if safety seal bearing "Sealed for your protection" under cap is torn or missing.
storage_conditions_description: Tablets should be stored below 25˚ C and protected from light & moisture.
